description: This file defines an abstract controller class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system's functional testing plugin. It manages a database backup service and customizes HTTP responses, serving as a base class for concrete controllers.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract controller for OrangeHRM's functional testing plugin that provides database backup service management and custom response headers.

methods.name: getDatabaseBackupService
methods.description: Returns an instance of DatabaseBackupService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set JSON content type headers on the response.
